deduction_content: The knee of the front leg is not above the instep
The thigh of the bending front leg is not parallel to the ground
Any portion of the sole of the rear leg is obviously off the floor
The rear foot is not hooked inwards with the toes pointing obliquely forwards

questions.question: What is the error code for Gōng Bù (Bow Stance)?
What are the deduction points for Gōng Bù (Bow Stance)?
questions.answer: Deductions are applied when: 1) The knee of the front leg is not above the instep, 2) The thigh of the bending front leg is not parallel to the ground, 3) Any portion of the sole of the rear leg is obviously off the floor, 4) The rear foot is not hooked inwards with the toes pointing obliquely forwards.
